facts.text: The Tiger Promise guarantees coverage of tuition and mandatory fees for eligible first-time freshmen for up to 8 consecutive semesters or 4 years.

sources.title: Tiger Promise - Texas Southern University
sources.quote: For eligible first-time freshmen at Texas Southern University (TSU), the Tiger Promise guarantees coverage of tuition and mandatory fees for up to 8 consecutive semesters or 4 years, including summer and winter sessions.
